game-intro: Pit tha nummers thegither an win tae tha 2048 tile!
game-explanation: Uise yer arra keys tae shïft tha tiles. Whan twa tiles wi tha yin nummer touch, the' rin thegither intae yin!
copy-warning: <note>Note:</note> Thïs steid is <emph>no</emph> tha offeecial version o 2048, but it's only tha translation strings that's dïffrent. Ye can play tha offeecial version on yer phone at <official-site>http://git.io/2048.</official-site> Aa ither aps or steids is taen frae thïs yin (lake thïs yin) or's fakes, an shud be uised wi tak tent.
translations: Thïs variant haes tryin-oot, fowk-made, no-finisht-yit translations - see <weblate>thïs Weblate project</weblate> fur mair on it.
